university.name: Cranfield University
university.summary: A postgraduate-focused UK university with its main campus at Cranfield in Bedfordshire. It works with businesses on research, postgraduate education and professional development, and teaches MSc courses in engineering, technology, management and related fields.

courses.title: Data Science and Artificial Intelligence for Sustainability
courses.overview: A one-year taught master's applying data science and artificial intelligence to energy and sustainability problems, combining programming, spatial data, environmental assessment and energy economics with an individual project.
courses.academic_requirements: A UK first or second class undergraduate degree with honours, as a minimum, or equivalent international qualification. A related science or engineering background is preferred.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 5.5 in each skill. PTE Academic 65 overall with 59 in each skill. TOEFL iBT: for tests taken before 21 January 2026, 92 total with minimums of 18 reading, 17 listening, 20 speaking and 17 writing; for tests from 21 January 2026, 4.5 overall with 4 in each skill. Tests must be within two years of the start date and all scores from a single test.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Cranfield's international entry requirements page lists, for Pakistan, a four-year Bachelor degree with Second division (high) as the 2:1 equivalent and Second division (low) as the 2:2 equivalent. Pakistani nationals must verify their qualification through Qualification Check. The page gives no percentage or CGPA figures.
courses.career_notes: Example roles listed on the course page include Energy Analyst, Data Scientist (Energy and Sustainability) and Digital Transformation Lead (Energy and Utilities).
courses.application_deadline_note: No application deadline is listed on the course page.
courses.notes: Page states start in October with entry year metadata of 2026 and no explicit 2027 start date, so the intake label has no year. Degree class set to 2:2 because the page says first or second class honours; the Pakistan page says most courses accept a 2:2 equivalent but some need a 2:1. pk_route bachelor_16 is the four-year bachelor named on the Pakistan entry. TOEFL left null because the published scale changed on 21 January 2026.

courses.title: Business Data Analytics
courses.overview: A one-year full-time master's in Cranfield School of Management covering analytics, programming, machine learning and optimisation for business decisions. Taught modules make up 70 per cent of the course and an individual thesis the remaining 30 per cent.
highlights: Predictive Analytics, Machine Learning and AI (compulsory)
courses.academic_requirements: A UK first or second class honours undergraduate degree, or an equivalent international qualification. A prior degree with a quantitative methods module, or a thesis with significant quantitative content, is described as ideal.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS (Academic, Online or UKVI) 6.5 overall with 5.5 in each component. PTE Academic 65 overall with 59 in each component. TOEFL iBT: for tests taken before 21 January 2026, 92 total with minimums of 18 reading, 17 listening, 20 speaking and 17 writing; from 21 January 2026, 4.5 overall and 4 in each component. All elements from one test taken within two years of the start date.
courses.experience_requirements: None stated. The page describes the course as designed for early to mid-career students.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Cranfield's international entry requirements page lists, for Pakistan, a four-year Bachelor degree with Second division (high) as the 2:1 equivalent and Second division (low) as the 2:2 equivalent. Pakistani nationals must verify their qualification through Qualification Check. The page gives no percentage or CGPA figures.
courses.career_notes: The course page names possible employment in finance, consulting, retail, manufacturing and pharmaceuticals, as well as the public sector, NGOs and education.
courses.application_deadline_note: No application deadline is listed on the course page. A deposit of GBP 2,000 is stated.
courses.notes: The only intake visible on the page is 28 September 2026, which has already begun, so no future intake label is recorded. The 2027/28 fee is shown on the page (the 2026/27 fee page lists a different, lower amount). Degree class set to 2:2 because the page says first or second class honours. TOEFL left null because the scale changed on 21 January 2026.

courses.title: Advanced Mechanical Engineering
courses.overview: A one-year taught master's in mechanical engineering with eight compulsory taught modules, a group project and an individual project. Subjects include component design, stress analysis, thermal systems and computational fluid dynamics for renewable energy.
highlights: Engineering Stress Analysis: Theory and Simulations (compulsory)
Computational Fluid Dynamics for Renewable Energy (compulsory)
courses.academic_requirements: A UK first or second class undergraduate honours degree as a minimum, or an equivalent international qualification. A related engineering or applied science background is ideal. International students who need a visa must obtain ATAS clearance.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS (Academic, Online or UKVI Academic) 6.5 overall with 5.5 in all skill components. PTE Academic 65 overall with 59 in all skill components. TOEFL iBT: for tests taken before 21 January 2026, 92 total with minimums of 18 reading, 17 listening, 20 speaking and 17 writing; from 21 January 2026, 4.5 overall with 4 in all components.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Cranfield's international entry requirements page lists, for Pakistan, a four-year Bachelor degree with Second division (high) as the 2:1 equivalent and Second division (low) as the 2:2 equivalent. Pakistani nationals must verify their qualification through Qualification Check. The page gives no percentage or CGPA figures.
courses.career_notes: Graduate destinations listed on the course page include Airbus, Jaguar Land Rover, Siemens and GKN Land Systems.
courses.application_deadline_note: No application deadline is listed on the course page.
courses.notes: Page states start in October with entry year metadata of 2026 and no explicit 2027 start date, so the intake label has no year. Degree class set to 2:2 because the page says first or second class honours. ATAS clearance is required for visa applicants. TOEFL left null because the scale changed on 21 January 2026.
